ReportUserDialog.title: Report User
ReportUserDialog.info: Reports are reviewed by moderators. False reports may result in account penalties.
ReportUserDialog.gameIdTooltip: If the report is related to a specific game, enter its ID.
ReportUserDialog.descriptionPlaceholder: Please describe what happened. Include dates, game details, or any evidence if available.
ReportUserDialog.chatEmpty: No chat context available (not triggered from chat).
ReportUserDialog.chatNote: This chat log is captured from your local chat window and may not reflect the full conversation.
ReportUserDialog.submittedMessage: Your report has been submitted and will be reviewed by a moderator. Thank you.

validation.description: Please describe what happened before submitting.
validation.gameId: Enter a game number, or leave it empty.

error.tooManyRequests: You have reached the daily report limit. Please try again later.
error.nameNotFound: The reported user could not be found. Guests (unregistered users) cannot be reported.
error.generic: Failed to submit report. Please try again.

categoryTooltip.cheating: Using external tools, cheat programs, or exploiting game bugs
categoryTooltip.bug_abuse: Exploiting a bug or glitch to gain an unfair advantage
categoryTooltip.harassment: Threatening, bullying, or persistent unwanted contact
categoryTooltip.verbal_abuse: Abusive or offensive language directed at another player
categoryTooltip.hate_speech: Discriminatory language targeting race, gender, religion, etc.
categoryTooltip.other: Any behavior not covered by the above categories
